part2.question: Describe an enjoyable evening you had with your friends

segments.v: I want to talk about an evening with my friends last June. It was after our final exams. There were five of us. We went to Linh's house. Her house has a rooftop and we cooked hotpot there. We bought food at the market and cooked together. It was very funny because we made many mistakes. After dinner, we went to the walking street near Hoàn Kiếm Lake. We ate ice cream and watched people singing and dancing. Then we sat by the lake and talked until 11 pm. It was enjoyable because we were free after the exams. We laughed a lot and we talked about our future. We didn't use our phones. I think it was one of the best evenings in my life.

fluency.band6: Events in order; “very funny” used wrongly.
fluency.band9: Build-up (weeks of study) → the evening in stages → why enjoyable (relief, silly → deep) → reflection (“on paper”).

lexical.band6: rooftop, cooked, walking street, talked, free, laughed.
lexical.band9: non-stop, pooled our money, pedestrian street, street performers, relief, be silly, reminisced, drifting apart, on paper.

grammar.band9: Past perfect continuous (We'd been studying non-stop for weeks), past perfect (our conversations had all been about…), passive (is closed to traffic), and participle clause (sitting by the lake, the conversation turned…).

analysis.keyDifference: Band 6 “It was very funny because we made many mistakes” means “funny” in the wrong sense for chaos (better: “fun” / “hilarious”). Band 9 contrasts weeks of stress with release, moves from silly to deep, and reflects on why a simple evening mattered.
